Retrieves the run history of schedules.

Note: If the `scheduleName` query parameter is not provided, the run histories of all schedules are returned. If one or more schedule names are provided in the `scheduleName` query parameter, the run histories of the specified schedules are returned.

Examples:
scheduleName=Test1 - Retrieves the run history of the schedule `ScheduleName1`.
scheduleName=ScheduleName1,ScheduleName2 - Retrieves the run histories of the schedules `Test1` and `Test3`
